name: Page Shell
description: The frame of every page: sticky black GlobalHeader, main content in the centred container, black GlobalFooter.

provenance.tag: Live (black 48px header, black footer with white 14px text). File A's white 80px header is not used (D1).

structure:
[GlobalHeader — black bar, 48px, sticky]                       ← Live (black, 48px). File A's white 80px is not used (D1).
[Main — --color-bg-page]
  └─ [Container: content up to 1280px, centred, padding-inline --page-margin]
       └─ [Page content]
[GlobalFooter — black, white 14px text]                        ← Live

GlobalHeader layout:
[Logo (bilingual lockup)] [Primary nav links ............] [Region/Language] [Currency] [Skywards login]

regions.name: Main
regions.description: --color-bg-page. Container: content up to 1280px, centred, padding-inline --page-margin.

responsive.behavior: Header links collapse into a menu toggle; the menu opens as a drawer.

rtl: Utility selectors sit at the end of the bar (right in English, left in Arabic); the logo moves to the right in Arabic.
rules: Nav items "Book, Manage, Where We Fly, Experience, Skywards": A · unverified.
Active link: 3px bottom bar in --color-action-primary (--border-width-3): A · unverified.
